name: Philips India
description: Philips India is the Indian subsidiary of global health technology and consumer electronics major Koninklijke Philips N.V.

stock.note: Philips India is a privately registered entity in India (CIN: U31902WB1930PLC006663); parent Koninklijke Philips N.V. is publicly listed on Euronext under ticker PHIA.AS.

marketing_spend.derivation: Estimated using category-level Indian AdEx benchmarks for consumer electronics and personal care appliances, assuming an estimated 8-12% share of category marketing spend for Philips India.
